messages:
alex: quick sync — proposing we add a new top-level field `vector_features` to console telemetry events to support vectorized routing/embedding-based aggregation. short-term plan is to store as jsonb array of floats.

morgan: curious — why jsonb and not a separate vector table? would save space if sparse.

alex: two reasons: 1) preserves single-event atomicity so downstream dashboards don't need joins, 2) easier canary with dual-write adapter. long-term we can consider denorming.

samir: downside is indexability. if we want k-NN lookups we likely need a separate vector index (pgvector) or external store. are we expecting kNN at ingest time or just post-hoc analytics?

alex: mostly post-hoc for now (quality/regression signals + routing profile clustering). we may add lightweight similarity checks for feature hashing during routing later.

priya: dashboards will explode if payload size balloons. what's the expected per-event size and retention change?

alex: estimate +2.4KB per event for 256-d float32; with current retention that is ~12% increase in ingest volume for console telemetry. we should test with a 1% canary.

morgan: can we quantize to float16 or int8 before write? that would cut size, but we need guarantees about downstream consumers knowing the type.

alex: yup — we propose a vector_profile enum: ["raw_f32", "f16_q", "int8_q"]. default for canary = "f16_q". adapter will expose profile in the event envelope.

samir: sample SQL for read adapter? thinking of how to store and backfill.

alex: ```sql
-- schema patch (add column)
ALTER TABLE console_events
  ADD COLUMN vector_features jsonb DEFAULT NULL;
-- lightweight index for existence checks
CREATE INDEX idx_console_events_vector_exists ON console_events((vector_features IS NOT NULL));
```

morgan: for canary we should dual-write to new column + existing kafka topic. and add a feature-flagged read-path in the console service to prefer vector_features when present.

priya: need QA on dashboards: any dashboard that materializes event size or aggregates size per-route will need a safety guard. propose a migration-runbook entry and a dashboard smoke test that compares ingest rates and p99 payload.

ingest-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-window=2024-05-08T20:00Z..2024-05-08T23:00Z; alert on >5% increase in producer latency.

samir: backfill plan? we can't recompute vectors for historical events cheaply. do we accept nulls and only populate forward, or run an offline job for last 30d?

alex: default is forward-only. offline backfill for 7d window if product wants historical vectors. add opt-in backfill job with throttling.

morgan: migration phases suggestion: 1) schema add + index, 2) feature-flag dual-write into canary->10% routes, 3) monitor ingest cost + dashboards, 4) decide on pgvector table vs external index if kNN needs arise, 5) gradual rollout.

priya: agree. also add a compatibility shim on read-side: if vector_features null, surface "vector_unavailable" in the UI, don't crash aggregation pipelines.

alex: outstanding asks: - eng-platform to run cost delta estimate with sample payloads (morgan) - eng-runtime to implement dual-write adapter + profile enum (samir) - product/console to add dashboard smoke tests + UI guard (priya) - infra to schedule canary window and alert thresholds (ingest-bot)

morgan: i'll run cost delta using last week's traffic sample and post numbers here by EOD.

samir: i'll start a branch for the dual-write adapter and add a small unit test for profile wiring.

priya: i'll draft the runbook and the dashboard smoke queries. want to include a p99 payload size check and a route-level ingest delta alert.

alex: thanks — if no objections we'll start the schema PR tomorrow and attach the runbook and canary plan. :thumbsup:
